title: Prediction / Premonition / Synchronism — Canonical Routing Index
purpose: Keep predictions, visions, cultural resonances, propagation claims, creative clues and synchronisms traceable without mixing evidentiary classes.

routes.topic: visions / AI / machine / culture / Spudlight extension
seven seals — biblical sequence + Tim-first reverse chronology + creative clues
routes.rule: Do not convert motif resemblance into numbered-seal fulfillment without chronology, specificity and mismatch audit.
Use its prior-specific/symbolic/typological/retrospective/synchronism distinctions together with the newer A-U audit taxonomy.
External timing/symbol pairing is not prophecy evidence by itself.
Generated hits are candidate retrieval only and require human source/outcome audit.

evidence_ladder: exact timestamped primary prediction before independent event
dated primary directional statement before later development
dated creative artifact with specific motifs before later interpretation/event
dated solution proposal that later converges with independent policy/technology
dated prior symbol whose later match requires interpretation
internal project forecast followed by internal project fulfillment
core_rule: Never use 'Tim predicted X' merely because Tim previously used a symbol later associated with X. Preserve the interesting chronology, then grade specificity, independence, public knowability, misses and alternative explanations.
repeatable_workflow: run scripts/mine_prediction_signals.py after large corpus imports
include songs/art filenames/lyrics as creative-source candidates with source class preserved
review top candidates and recover original source
promote only useful candidates into unresolved queue
move resolved cases into main prediction audit with grade
